items.description: File category the generator must read.

referencedTags.description: Tags from other configurations whose classes may be referenced in code generated by this module's generators.

additionalProperties.description: Name of the configuration from which to retrieve the tag.

oneOf.description:
Configuration languages, applied in order to select the corresponding domain, decorator, and converter implementation.

- Default: `sql`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

Configuration languages, applied in order to select the corresponding domain, decorator, and converter implementation.

- Default: `sql`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

variables.description: Global configuration variables that can be used in all configuration properties.

tagVariables.description: Per-tag configuration variables that can be used in configuration properties that support them.

rootModule.description:
Root module definition used for grouping generated artifacts, such as translation files.

- Default: `{module:head}`.
- Templating: `{module}`.

ignoreDefaultValues.description:
Disables generation of default property values in classes and endpoints generated with this configuration.

- Default: `true`.

translateReferences.description:
Whether reference list labels must be translated in this configuration.

- Default: the value set in the global `i18n` section.

translateProperties.description:
Whether property labels must be translated in this configuration.

- Default: the value set in the global `i18n` section.

disable.description: Generators to disable for this configuration.

oneOf.description:
Uses lowercase table and column names.

- Default: `true`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

Uses lowercase table and column names.

- Default: `true`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.

tablesFileName.description:
Name of the file containing the table creation script.

- Default: `01_tables.sql`.

indexesAndKeysFileName.description:
Name of the file containing the script for creating indexes and foreign and unique keys.

- Default: `02_indexes_and_keys.sql`.

valuesFileName.description:
Name of the file containing the initial-value insertion script.

- Default: `03_values.sql`.

resourcesFileName.description:
Name of the file containing the resource insertion script (translated labels).

- Default: `04_resources.sql`.

typesFileName.description:
Name of the file containing the type creation script (for SQL Server).

- Default: `05_types.sql`.

commentsFileName.description: Name of the file containing the script for creating table and column comments.

tableScriptFolder.description: Project folder for table declaration scripts.

tableTypeScriptFolder.description: Project folder for table type declaration scripts.

initListScriptFolder.description: Project folder for reference list initialization scripts.

initListMainScriptName.description: Project file referencing reference list initialization scripts.

generateComments.description:
Generates SQL comments on tables and columns.

- Default: `false`.

tableTablespace.description: Tablespace name for tables (PostgreSQL or Oracle).

indexTablespace.description: Tablespace name for indexes (PostgreSQL or Oracle).
